A '''terentatek''' was frozen in ice in the depths of the ice [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Keres II]], but was freed from the ice by [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]] miners during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], leading the miners to flee their outpost in fear of the [[Sithspawn/Legends|Sithspawn]].
